target_customer: Independent veterinary practices that pay for front-desk automation
problem: Vet front desks are overloaded with calls for appointments, triage and prescription requests. Scritch's AI receptionist Emily answers calls 24/7 and integrates with practice systems.
product_category: AI voice receptionist for veterinary care

founders.name: Claire Lee
founders.background_notes: Company site says the founders are sisters.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time voice agents, triage logic and integrations with phone and practice management systems are standard for 2024 voice AI, with clinical safety care needed.

defensibility.rationale: Practice system integrations help, but many generic AI receptionist vendors target vet clinics per 2026 results.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: 2026 results show many generic AI answering services and a competitor launching a vet receptionist in July 2026; dated 2024 competitors were not found.

market_need_then: Vet clinics are staff-constrained and phone-heavy; a customer on the site reports human-handled calls dropped over 50%, a company-published testimonial.

branding.domain_note: Uses scritchai.com, with an AI suffix, not scritch.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, treats the product as a team member for vet staff

brand_strength.rationale: A playful pet-related name and a named persona, but no press about the brand or community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Scritch is an active YC W24 company selling an AI voice receptionist to vet practices, with four named practices on its site. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found and no verified funding beyond YC, so the outcome is open and depends on beating broader AI receptionist vendors.
notes: CB Insights lists a $0.5M convertible note from Y Combinator on 2024-04-04, VCBacked a pre-seed in 2024-03 and geo.sig.ai a July 2024 seed; aggregators only, stage and date conflict, so not recorded as a round. Some aggregators describe Scritch as a vet concierge membership ($189 per year); this may be an earlier model but no dated source confirms a pivot. Competitor search returned only undated or 2026 vendor pages, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: the 500K convertible note dated 2024-04-04 is recorded from CB Insights alone (stage other); other aggregators give pre-seed 2024-03 or seed 2024-07, so the date rests on a single database. No press found.
